title: silene schischkinii
intro: Silene schischkinii, commonly known as Mountain Catchfly, is a plant species in the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Russian Far East, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Silene schischkinii include wound healing, immune system support, and the alleviation of respiratory issues. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
